en.t: Black 69's wedge was called a brilliant move.

units.source_text: 连名人后来也讲评说：这是大竹七段独创的强攻。

en.t: Even the Master later commented that this was a powerful attack of Otake 7-dan's own invention.

units.source_text: 倘若应着错误，就势必给白子造成不可收拾的局面。

en.t: If the reply was mistaken, it would inevitably create an irretrievable position for White.

units.source_text: 所以名人下白70，用时一小时四十六分。

en.t: Therefore, when the Master played White 70, he used one hour and forty-six minutes.

units.source_text: 十天后，即八月五日，白90用时两小时零七分，这是名人在这盘中思考最长的一次。

en.t: Ten days later, on August 5, White 90 took two hours and seven minutes, the longest think the Master had in this game.

units.source_text: 白70这一手，是仅次于此的长考。

en.t: The move White 70 was the next longest think after that.
